images.alt:
Elon Musk now says he isn’t MAGA. Interesting development from a guy who recently called himself “dark MAGA,” campaigned for Trump, joined his administration, and spent hundreds of millions of dollars getting MAGA republicans elected. Apparently, he has a considerable amount of confusion about the meaning of terms. 

In 2024, Musk spent at least $288 million helping elect Trump and other Republicans. He wore the MAGA hat, repeatedly appeared at Trump rallies, and proudly announced that he was “dark MAGA.” He then joined the Trump administration and ran DOGE, where he participated in dismantling federal agencies.

In 2025, he poured millions into the Wisconsin Supreme Court election, even personally handing out million-dollar checks at a campaign event. His preferred candidate lost.

In 2026, he contributed roughly $446 million to political groups, including $168 million to the Senate Leadership Fund and $216 million to America PAC, helping fund Republican campaigns across the country. As recently as November 3, he was telling his followers to “Vote red today!”

Then, on November 18, Musk announced that he wasn’t MAGA and admitted feeling foolish about spending all that money.

A remarkable turnaround. After spending more than $700 million supporting MAGA over two election cycles, wearing the hat, campaigning for the candidates, and actually working in the administration, Musk has apparently determined that none of this should be interpreted as evidence of his political affiliation.
